text:
maria: Quick postmortem follow-up. We're seeing a repeating cascade: cloud transient -> auth token surge -> model-registry timeouts -> brief customer errors. Need a single remediation tracker, owners, and a monthly check-in. Who can take point? :mag:
aj: I can own the tracker and rotate owners monthly. I'll create a sheet (owner, status, priority, SLA mapping). Can someone export 90d vendor-filtered incidents and alerts? :file_folder:
liam: I'll pull logs and generate a vendor-by-week heatmap with deploy markers and time-of-day spikes. ETA EOD today.
sre_lead: Please add columns: failure_mode (auth/registry/infra), short_term_mitigation, and blocker flag. Also audit circuit-breaker thresholds and autoscaler backoff; our retries might be amplifying the blips.
kate: I'll map runbooks against the incidents and propose patches for token jitter handling and cross-region retry logic. Draft by Tue AM.
security: I'll review KMS rotation windows and token TTLs. If rotations are synchronized we could be causing auth surges; propose jitter/stagger by Monday.
oncall-bot: Linked INC-2026-0413-07 to this thread and created tracker item DEC-2026-0413-01 assigned to AJ.
aj: Actions (please react with :white_check_mark: when claimed):
- AJ: remediation tracker (sheet + owner tags) 26-04-15
- LIAM: heatmap + 90d extracts 26-04-13
- KATE: runbook gap doc + patches 26-04-14
- SECURITY: rotation review & jitter proposal 26-04-13
- SRE_LEAD: circuit-breaker & autoscaler config review 26-04-16
- TEAM: monthly dependency failover drill proposal 26-04-20
liam: ack. I'll include the queries and a tiny script. Example: `journalctl -u svc-model-registry | grep -E "(timeout|401|503)" > /tmp/registry-errors.log` then run `python tools/heatmap.py`.
sre_lead: Short-term mitigation proposals to evaluate: 1) Per-route fallback to cached snapshot (v1-small) when registry latency >200ms for short windows; 2) Synthetic canary every 12h to validate failover. Prototype router rule to test: `if registry_latency_ms > 200 and error_rate > 0.02: route -> cached_snapshot:v1-small; notify -> #incidents`.
kate: For the monthly drill, propose a scoped "auth-provider burst" scenario to simulate 500s on token endpoint and measure time-to-fallback, alert coverage, and user-error delta. I'll draft the drill runbook and checklist.
security: I'll add a vendor-SLA mapping tab in the tracker so runbook actions map to contract coverage (many SLAs exclude short auth spikes).
aj: I'll create a recurring calendar item "dependency resilience review" and rotate owners monthly. Who volunteers for the first rotation? Reply here.
maria: Thanks. Two asks before close: 1) Add postmortem link to the tracker; 2) Mark infra fallback work as blocker/high priority. Scheduling Wed 09:00 sync to review heatmap + tracker. Leaving thread open for updates through Monday. Tag @maria or @aj if blocked. :calendar: :eyes:
